ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 9:1 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white field across both lobes; low-intensity black border continuous along the trailing and leading edges; one distinct dark circular focal spot in the medial-lower quadrant of the left lobe; a cluster of irregular dark pixel blobs concentrated at the central base/peduncle junction.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a vertex angle of approximately 110 degrees, extending to a pixel depth of roughly 15% of the vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations present along the entire trailing edge boundary; the distal right edge exhibits higher-amplitude jagged peaks compared to the more uniform left edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature characterized by a symmetrical inward sweep from the lateral tips toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast dark pixel points on the extreme distal tips of both lobes, particularly prominent on the right fluke tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Single prominent dark circular pigment mark on the left lobe; irregular dark markings at the fluke-peduncle insertion point.
